model: PathBone-MF release (PNI: desc+ECFP3+B_gene+MolFormer; mechanism: GEO-anchored E pathway bottleneck; strict 135-drug holdout)

evaluation_design.PNI_135: 135 unique drugs independent hold-out (all profiles and scaffold-overlap training profiles excluded); drug-level aggregation; direct argmax
evaluation_design.external_validation: GSE28074 BMP6-induced hMSC osteoblast differentiation; E anchors are built WITHOUT GSE28074 to keep validation independent

gse28074_pathway_validation.design: 10 osteogenic drugs -> E_gene pathway scores vs BMP6-induced hMSC differentiation; E trained without GSE28074
gse28074_pathway_validation.interpretation: Independent GEO validation: E anchor model improves pathway-level agreement, especially 24-96h osteogenic program; late-stage direction also improves from negative/weak to positive.

primary_claims: PathBone-MF integrates RDKit descriptors, ECFP3, LINCS-generated B_gene, and MoLFormer molecular representation
Pathway-level external validation against GSE28074 hMSC osteoblast differentiation
GEO-anchored E pathway bottleneck (3,253 pathways) for mechanistic output; trained without GSE28074
978 -> 12,328 gene expansion from LINCS level5 ridge imputation
Strict no-leak evaluation: 135 test drugs and shared-scaffold training profiles excluded; I-recall decision bias tuned on training CV only
limitations: Clean 131-unique-drug holdout accuracy 75.6%, 3-class AUC 0.890; still modest for clinical decisions
MorganFP+MLP has comparable accuracy/P-I AUC but no pathway/gene mechanistic output
LINCS transcriptome is cell-line based, not primary bone cells
Chondrocyte/osteocyte axes are exploratory and less well calibrated
Single-timepoint static response; does not simulate differentiation dynamics or cell-cell coupling

PNI_independent_test_135_clean.model: clean unified-DDPM B_gene + RDKit descriptors + ECFP3 -> LogisticRegression(C=5, balanced)

gse28074_pathway_validation_previous_DDP.design: 10 osteogenic drugs averaged -> pathway scores vs BMP6-induced hMSC differentiation
gse28074_pathway_validation_previous_DDP.interpretation: Early osteogenic program (8-24h) shows positive pathway-level agreement; late mineralization weaker

E_no28074_strict_135.design: E_gene + RDKit descriptors + ECFP3 -> LogisticRegression(C=5, balanced); same 131 unique drug holdout as B
E_no28074_strict_135.role: E is for gene/pathway mechanistic output and GEO external validation; B_gene remains the PNI classifier

PNI_independent_test_135_clean_I_tuned.model: clean unified-DDPM B_gene + RDKit + ECFP3 -> LogisticRegression(C=5, balanced); I-probability decision bias 0.5
PNI_independent_test_135_clean_I_tuned.selection: bias selected on training-drug 5-fold CV only; 135-drug holdout evaluated once after selection
PNI_independent_test_135_clean_I_tuned.note: I recall improved from 0.659 to 0.864 while overall accuracy remains 0.748; P precision improved; N recall tradeoff is explicit.

PNI_independent_test_135_MF.model: RDKit descriptors + ECFP3 + unified-DDPM B_gene + MolFormer(mean-pooled 768) -> LogisticRegression(C=0.3, balanced)

axis_classifiers_135_MF.evaluation: fixed 135-drug holdout; each axis trained on training drugs only

adipocyte.note: training LOOCV unstable, interpret as exploratory

chondrocyte.note: only 5 independent test drugs; exploratory only

axis_classifiers_135_MF.primary_axis_claim: Only osteoblast/osteoclast/adipocyte should be reported as calibrated; chondrocyte is exploratory.

external_benchmark_131_drugs.design: Same 131 unique test drugs; PathBone B_gene vs MiTCP pretrained model vs observed LINCS profiles.
external_benchmark_131_drugs.conclusion: Neither model generalizes well at quantitative 978-gene prediction on this independent set; PathBone-MF advantage is bone-specific P/I/N and four-axis classifiers plus pathway/gene mechanistic output, not quantitative transcriptome prediction.
